name: MGF and PEG-MGF
status_note: Monograph draft, not yet reviewed. Status verified from secondary sources.
sequence_note: The 24-residue sequence shown is the rat IGF-1Ec E-domain peptide (commonly called MGF); the human IGF-1 E-peptide differs (longer C-terminus; UniProt P05019).
structure_note: IGF-1Ec C-terminal peptide; the PEG-MGF form carries polyethylene glycol (not depicted).
